name: Google來源會議內部邀請與逐人行程同步
requiresDatabases: Existing meeting plans and Calendar documents
definitionOfDone: Host can invite internal colleagues from external Calendar workspaces
Internal membership survives recipient Google failures
Original host event is never copied
Existing recipient UID/occurrence reused without modifying original event
Deterministic writes and frozen targets prevent duplicate retries
Calendar read links invited colleagues back to the same workspace
Per-person outcomes are visible without resetting pending edits
Production preserves original records and all unrelated Worker modules
